# Core Rule 12 - Players must be and act at least 18 years old All players must be at least 18 years old. Additionally, all players must act at least as mature as an 18 year old. Admins may ban someone who they believe is acting less mature than an 18 year old, even if the player is known to be significantly older than 18 years old.
Anyone who connects to the servers is a player, even if they don't actually play in a round.
